scientific_question: At fixed sparse-coordinate budget, can exact-current, multi-pass residual fitting materially increase attention c_proj coverage beyond the one-pass output chart that failed under refresh-15 feedback?

theory.premise: Dense trajectory attribution assigns the dominant remaining full-attention penalty to c_proj plus its V interaction. Its dense Muon motion is overwhelmingly rotational, with terminal full output-orbit recovery 0.512522 versus input-orbit recovery 0.138157 and singular-changing recovery about 0.00295.
theory.mechanism: Each pass chooses sparse Givens connectivity from the exact same-state residual request. This tests local coordinate coverage only; temporal carry is deliberately excluded because the prior failure confounded stale refresh and carry chasing.
theory.control_logic: output96 tests whether more coordinates alone suffice. Structured candidates may be selected only if they also beat output96 by a frozen ratio at the identical 36,864-coordinate budget.

decision_rule.selection: Among passing candidates maximize aggregate fixed-scale recovery minus coordinate fraction; ties prefer fewer coordinates.
decision_rule.pass: Authorize implementation of only the selected c_proj structure, followed by tests and an exact-config >=20% MFU gate. Training remains separately gated.
decision_rule.fail: Reject additional sparse-Givens depth/bilateral composition for c_proj and return to a non-orthogonal low-memory transport design.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling; no watchdog or callback
